classification_semantics.R11_CANONICAL_CANDIDATE: Current R11 writer surface eligible for later integrated cutover review; this registry does not grant canonical authority.
classification_semantics.LEGACY_REFERENCE_ONLY: Legacy/oracle/reference surface; call/import reachability cannot upgrade it to authority.
classification_semantics.QUALIFICATION_ONLY: Stage qualification harness or workflow; may exercise writers but cannot own production authority.
classification_semantics.TEST_ONLY: Test fixture/harness writer; cannot own production authority.
classification_semantics.NON_AUTHORITATIVE_READ_ONLY: Identity/protocol/read-only surface; no authoritative mutation role.
classification_semantics.UNKNOWN_AUTHORITY: Fail-closed unresolved mutation surface; any occurrence makes the audit fail.
